Zixlabs PharmaScanMobile code evaluation

PharmaScan

A mobile application for reading, interpreting and comparing GS1 DataMatrix and Pharmacode information during engineering and QA evaluation.

Offline decodingCore decoding can be used without relying on a live data connection.
GS1 interpretationSupported application identifiers are separated into clear, readable data.
Pharmacode comparisonCapture carton and leaflet Pharmacodes for a focused comparison workflow.
On-device historyKeep recent evaluation results available for review on the device.
iOSComing soon to theApple App Store AComing soon toGoogle Play

Read the PharmaScan privacy policy →

Engineering and QA evaluation: PharmaScan is intended to support evaluation activities. It does not replace validated production equipment, approved procedures or independent verification.

SQC Pro

Steam Quality Calculator Pro

A complete mobile engineering application for recording, calculating and reporting steam-quality test results across dryness value, superheat and non-condensable gas assessments.

Selectable test planChoose from zero to three repeats of each test to match the work being completed.
Three test calculationsGuided workflows for dryness value, superheat and non-condensable gas testing.
PASS / FAIL assessmentReview a clear assessment for each completed test and the overall test sequence.
PDF report outputProduce a structured report based on the tests and repeat quantities selected by the user.
iOSDownload on theApple App Store

Read the SQC Pro privacy policy →

Engineering calculation support: SQC Pro is intended to support test calculations and reporting. It does not replace calibrated instruments, approved procedures, qualified personnel or independent review of results.
